expectations.text: Shows evidence of reading the existing context files (references Orders, Inventory, and/or Customers)
expectations.evidence: Lists Orders/Inventory/Customers tags and that Orders reads from the other two.

expectations.text: Raises the question of ownership or boundaries for a feature that reads across multiple existing contexts
expectations.evidence: Raises ownership ('owned by whoever owns the business needs to see numbers') and the read-only boundary.

expectations.text: Uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation
expectations.evidence: '**Q:** Is this purely read-only reporting, or will anyone act on it?' + Recommendation.

expectations.text: Treats reporting as likely a separate context rather than silently embedding it in one of the three
expectations.evidence: 'a new fourth area... reads from the other three rather than living inside any of them.'

expectations.text: Uses plain business language with NO DDD jargon in the user-facing text
expectations.evidence: Plain language ('new area', 'read-only'); no DDD jargon.

expectations.text: Keeps implementation details (ETL/event-store/query mechanics) out — stays at the ownership/boundary level
expectations.evidence: Stays at the ownership/boundary level; defers live-vs-copy mechanics, no ETL design.
